::: {.home-copy}

Most of the time, mathematics gets handed to us as a list of things to calculate. I have always been far more curious about the picture sitting underneath all that machinery: the reason a theorem has no choice but to be true, the quiet moment when a row of abstract symbols suddenly turns into something you can picture and almost touch.

This is where I work that out in the open. Each post starts from the simplest version of an idea I can find, builds up the intuition until the result feels inevitable, and only then writes down the formal proof. Where a picture or a few lines of runnable code make the idea easier to believe, I include them.

I write these mostly for the version of me who was once stuck on the very same thing. If you happen to be stuck there too, I hope they help.

:::

```{=html}
<script>
/* Pangu spacing — insert a half-width space (U+0020) at CJK <-> Latin/
   number boundaries for reading fluency (Apple-style typographic detail).
   Scoped to .home-page; skips code, math, and script/style nodes.
   English-only copy has no CJK boundaries, so wording is never changed. */
(function () {
  var CJK = '⺀-⻿⼀-⿟぀-ヿ㐀-䶿一-鿿豈-﫿＀-￯';
  var reAfterCJK  = new RegExp('([' + CJK + '])([A-Za-z0-9@&%$])', 'g');
  var reBeforeCJK = new RegExp('([A-Za-z0-9!~&%;=)\\]\\.\\:\\?])([' + CJK + '])', 'g');
  var SKIP = { SCRIPT: 1, STYLE: 1, CODE: 1, PRE: 1, KBD: 1, SAMP: 1, TEXTAREA: 1 };
  function walk(node) {
    for (var n = node.firstChild; n; n = n.nextSibling) {
      if (n.nodeType === 3) {
        var t = n.nodeValue;
        var s = t.replace(reAfterCJK, '$1 $2').replace(reBeforeCJK, '$1 $2');
        if (s !== t) n.nodeValue = s;
      } else if (n.nodeType === 1 && !SKIP[n.tagName] &&
                 !n.classList.contains('math') &&
                 n.tagName.toLowerCase().indexOf('mjx') !== 0) {
        walk(n);
      }
    }
  }
  function run() { var root = document.querySelector('.home-page'); if (root) walk(root); }
  if (document.readyState !== 'loading') run();
  else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
})();
</script>
```
